TOP — s(11) = s-hat, equality only for Trump mod G (S1) [open — own work done; waiting on dependencies] The composed theorem. Open until every 'open' descendant below closes. [own_tier lean-proved: the composition is already a Lean theorem from the axioms]

A.D1 — Attainment: s(11) is a minimum (D1) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A68): Lean theorem attained_thm (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). No Hausdorff limits: compactness of the coordinate feasible region (33 coords + side in [0,11]; containment = the set_subset_container_iff inequalities, non-overlap closed because interior(PSq.set) = the OPEN u/v box, mem_interior_iff_uv) + continuity of the side projection; explicit 11-in-a-row packing for nonemptiness; parametrize (A64) maps set-level packings in. TopLevel roster 13 -> 12 named axioms.

A.PARAM — Every packing is represented in (cx,cy,t), t in [0,1] [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A64): prose + Lean theorem (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). The square's own 90-degree symmetry (sqSet_rot) brings the edge vector into the closed first quadrant; the half-angle substitution t = e2/(1+e1) is exact algebra - no transcendental functions. Also provides the u/v membership and w-containment characterisations + w quasiconcavity that the measure bridge consumes.

A.LB382 — Theorem 1: s(11) >= 3.82 [lean-proved] Two independent exact verifiers (verify_measure.py; Lean checkMeasureI via native_decide) AND, since A64, the END-TO-END Lean theorem s_eleven_ge_382 (Measure382.lean): native_decide evaluation + the formalised bridge A.F2; axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound + the native_decide axiom. 'Lean proves s(11) >= 3.82', not just 'Lean checks the checker'.

A.S3 — s-hat is THE octic root (isolation certificate) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A63). The octic has exactly 2 real roots; the one in [3.877083, 3.877084] is the second; all Taylor coefficients at the left endpoint above degree 0 are positive, so the Lean uniqueness proof is calculus-free. 5 corruption gates fail as required.

A.UBshat — Upper bound AT s-hat exactly (Trump's packing exists at s-hat) [certificate+verifier] ROUTE DECIDED (A63, docs/proofs/attainment_ub.md): route (b) (Fits-closed + certificate sequence) REFUTED as a finite route (scaling breaks unit squares; rational curves have rational sigma-limits). Route (a) already certifies Fits(s_A22) (A22 feasibility, Python-interval TCB); residue = the algebraic identity s_A22 = s-hat, pinned to 2.1e-47 by T1's Taylor bound; closure specs: exact number-field verification (compositum deg <= 56 - a coordinate has a degree-7 minimal polynomial, so the field is NOT Q(s-hat)) or the S3-fallback restatement with s-hat := s_A22. || A64: axiom SPLIT executed in TopLevel.lean - shatA22 + trump_packs_at_shatA22 (certified, Python-interval TCB) + shatA22_eq_shat (THE open identity, single axiom); trump_packs_at_shat now a theorem. Sign/interval route to the identity REFUTED (no separation gap without a height bound - attainment_ub.md section 6); NEW cheaper closure spec (c-idl): saturated ideal-membership cofactor certificate, verification = rational polynomial identities + one sign gate, no number-field arithmetic; search = bounded Groebner/Macaulay campaign. || A69: (c-idl) EXECUTED - certs/cidl_identity.json + certs/verify_cidl.py (PASS 0.7 s, stdlib rationals; corruption gates OK): e(t)*Delta^8*octic(S) = sum q_j G_j over the 13 reduced contact rows, sign gate via exact Sturm on [3/10,2/5]; found by exact linear elimination (no Groebner) - deg Delta 34, deg D 35, m(t) = the tan-half octic DERIVED, m | G_oct. shatA22 = shat now certificate-backed (attainment_ub.md sec 7); the A53 L4 degree-7/compositum-56 obstacle VOID (spurious A03 minpoly annotations; all coordinates lie in Q(t-hat), degree 8). Lean residue = named obligation CIDL-LEAN (sec 7.5): native_decide replay + refined A22-interface axioms; then shatA22_eq_shat becomes a theorem via shat_spec.

A.UNIQ — Uniqueness transfer: EVERY packing at s-hat reaches a stratified representative mod G [open — own work done; waiting on dependencies] RE-DIAGNOSED (A63, docs/proofs/unique_transfer.md): the axiom AS STATED follows from census exhaustiveness (A53 L3); the hole moved into stratum_kill's forall-packings quantifier at the K1-protected classes. Full architecture on file: CC-2 teleport chain to a stuck packing + stuck-kills (H10-stuck) + residual/basin + COLLAPSE back via Theorem U (node A.THMU). Obligations U-O1..U-O4. A65: U-O1 DISCHARGED (Theorem U certified, docs/proofs/theorem_u.md); remaining: U-O2 (=H10-stuck, see C.K4TIER / docs/proofs/h10_stuck.md), U-O3 (A57 G1), U-O4 (D/E nodes as axiomatised). [own_tier proved-prose: the reduction is prose (unique_transfer.md); formalising the derivation in Lean is still owed even after dependencies close]

A.SBRIDGE — Lemma B: interior-disjoint packings vs closed-disjoint certificate families (lambda-dilation with pin slack, S4/F9) [lean-proved] LEAN-PROVED (A68, Dilation.lean): B.0(a) scaleC_disjoint (A64 pull-back trick replaces the SAT citation), B.0(b) = A64 scaleC_subset, B.0(c) slot_tracking ((lambda-1)*alpha exact, any beta), dilation_bridge (packing -> IsStrictFamily at lambda*m), lemma_B, AND the pricing pigeonhole priced_dichotomy/hcert_of_priced ((P1)+(P2) => bridged claim, Exempt-aware so B-NO = the same theorem), bprime_containment ((H') => (H)), pullback_mem_Icc (B.2'' widening). All axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound. RESIDUES: producing (P2) from a PASS file is V.CASE; B.2' owner-frame (tilted-core) criterion remains prose; corpus margin rho ~ 1.0000009e-9 remains a [M] computation (A63 scan, reproduced by A60 on 49 leaves). || A70: the '(P2) from a PASS file' residue is DISCHARGED (V.CASE lean-proved; checkCaseI_kill produces lemma_B's hcert per certificate).

A.THMU — Theorem U: one-square rigidity of z-hat (11 re-insertion certificates) [certificate+verifier] DISCHARGED AT CERTIFICATE LEVEL (A65, 2026-09-01): 11 re-insertion certificates u_reinsert_00..10 PASS (verify_case depth 60, Sigma w = 0, budget 1) at s''=3877083591023/1e12 with exact side-condition ledger (core margins ~1e-4, nofam-to-basin dev <= 1.0000010e-3 < rBasin); falsifier control FAILs exactly at Trump's pocket. Composition docs/proofs/theorem_u.md: consumes only basin's equality clause (not the open D-nodes). Trust residue: A22 z0/r0 enclosure (mpmath.iv tier) + two dps-80 tilt evals; both vanish under the t-reparametrised A22 re-emission (E.IV).

B.SEL — Selection: a k-maximal slide-stuck minimiser exists (H1 / L6 / CC-2) [proved-prose] CAVEAT (H1): degenerate slide cases (slide creating a contact mid-way, ties, sigma-changing slides) not written; not in docs/proofs/. A75 LEAN PARTIAL (Selection.lean): exists_kmax (the k-maximal selection, Nat.sSup_mem) + teleport_packing + cc2_stuck; H1 degenerate-case audit DONE - in the teleport (CC-2) formulation every listed case (mid-slide contact, ties, sigma-changing slides, one-normalisation simplicity) is absent by the shape of the statement; the sole residue is the census interface hinc (F11/H2).

B.CENSUS — Census: skeleton classes are exhaustive (1110 tuples / 163 D4 classes) [certificate+verifier] Exact Fractions enumeration, D4-reduced, Trump canary. **H2 CLOSED (A72, 2026-09-02): DOUBLY WITNESSED.** Clean-room re-enumeration from the written L1-L3 definition only (A53 code never opened; output sha256-frozen before the diff) reproduces the census EXACTLY: the 1110 slot-sets are identical as sets of exact rational plane points, the 163-orbit partition is identical, the two D4 groups coincide as maps on the 36-slot lattice, and Trump lands in the same class. sha256 tuple_set f035681aca981b050c4519ed4fde6d7e019f3be40a209dbea4a29af2e8934be2 (A72) vs skeletons_young.json a7d769a08c6d3327673be14f0babb380d46babdcc1e28c3fd1d96a7d17a83ef7 (A53). hface's computational content is now witnessed by two independent implementations. RESIDUE (unchanged): the DEFINITIONAL debt - InStratum is still opaque in the Lean statement (F11); and 12 written-definition ambiguities had to be resolved by hand to write the second enumerator (8 binding), listed in attempts/A72-census-cleanroom/notes/ambiguities.md - a Lean definition must pin all 8.

B.K1 — K1: kills climb containment, aliveness descends (H3) [lean-proved] E.1(i) LEAN-PROVED (A68, Skeleton.lean): slot model (corner + Young cell, affine slotCentre), ContainsPins (injective slot assignment), containsPins_mono + kill_mono - in the indexed slot model the prose slot-inclusion step is the Finset inclusion itself. E.1(ii) aliveness-descends stays prose: it is an LP-value (tau*) statement about which certificates CAN exist - completeness, never load-bearing in the composition.

B.EXACT — Exact-skeleton vs pin-monotone bridge [proved-prose] CLOSED for the certified part (A63): exactly => contains is reflexivity + D4 bookkeeping; the certificate's monotone form is strictly stronger. A68: Lean skeleton landed (monotone_to_exact, Skeleton.lean) with the census interface as an explicit hypothesis hface ("exact class membership => ContainsPins of the class tuple"); hface becomes a theorem only when the Young census is a Lean definition (F11/H2; D4 equivariance machine-checked computationally by A67 R8). The K1-protected tier is deliberately out of scope - that is H10, target form H10-stuck. A75: reviewed, unchanged; E.2 D4 bookkeeping (symmetry action on slots/configurations) still prose - to land with the census definition.

C.WIN — Window transfer: every kill valid on all of [3.82, s-hat] (H6) [certificate+verifier] PARTIAL: 38/52 strata full-window; 12 s0-only (A61 running); 2 partial slivers (k6_23, k6_07); A57 sub-tree kills s0-only. A56 REFUTED transfer-as-a-principle, so this cannot be factored out as a single lemma â€” it is a per-certificate obligation, which is why the Lean axiom fuses it into stratum_kill (findings F6). A63: the S4 application step (kill at the minimiser's own side) is now the WRITTEN Lemma B/B-prime of docs/proofs/closed_disjoint_bridge.md; full-window parametric coverage + dense rationals instantiate stratum_kill at every m in [3.82, s-hat] for covered classes. C.K61 — 61 pin-set kill certificates (k=3: 1, k=4: 8, k=5: 19, k=6: 33) [certificate+verifier] All exact, independently re-verified, corruption-gated. At s0; window coverage tracked at C.WIN.

C.A57 — k5_11 + k5_16 killed by sub-stratification trees [certificate+verifier] CAVEAT: s0-only (the sub-tree kills have no parametric window form yet); pinguard soundness gate closed the A54 substrat.py gap (H5). A63 SHARPENING (closed_disjoint_bridge B.3): with the library's eps-fat pin cores (margin ~1e-9) an s0-only certificate reaches only a ~4e-10-relative shell below s0, i.e. NO side of [3.82, s-hat]; upgrade = parametric tree or slack-core fixed-side grid (B.4). A63 follow-up: cover-invariance lemma PROVED (docs/proofs/cover_invariance.md) - the parametric route is theory-open; residue = 601 logic-kill C-checks + make_param/verify_param tool gaps + one 4D pass; slack-core grid (delta 1e-2, ~8 days, T21) is the measured alternative; routes compose per leaf. LIVE 2026-09-02: window campaign G1 RUNNING (4-side slack-core grid delta=1e-2 covering [3.81794, s0] with 95%-overlap slabs, V9/E4 gate clean; parametric skip-list as upside; first 4D window-wide PASS achieved on an eps_geo-repaired leaf; est 6.4 desktop-days, 4-5 w/ skip list).

C.K4TIER — k<=4 / k<=3 tier exclusion (H10) [open] THE LARGEST OPEN LEAF; A65 priced the re-based H10-STUCK routes (docs/proofs/h10_stuck.md): decoupled counting / conditioning / absorption / boosted-kill LP all DEAD - the crowd's value is pairwise. A66 (2026-09-02) executed the residue: (R2) corners4 direct integral counting REFUTED [T+M, docs/proofs/corners4_empty.md] - the centre-occupancy relaxation admits exact 7-point witnesses at EVERY window side (the 1.877 channel holds 3 centres lengthwise + 2 pin-edge + 2 wall-mid); emptiness is orientation-coupled, corners4 NOT deleted. (R1) pair certificates DESIGNED + SOUND [T, docs/proofs/pair_kill.md Lemma P/P0; spec docs/specs/pair_certificate_v1.md; new verifier attempts/A66-corners4-pair/code/verify_pair.py, NOT yet TCB]: stuckness rows = CC-2' 2-crowds only, bridge via Delta_lambda with slack cores + box widening 3(lambda-1); CANARY THEOREM: dilated Trump saturates the trump5 pair threshold C(6,2)+6*beta exactly - trump5 provably unkillable by the formalism; A34 collapse does not apply (pricing dual, no marginal gluing). PILOT [F]: k4_08 restricted pair value = 21+6*beta EXACTLY (margin -beta, zero fractional excess; integral optimum = the crowdfam ghost) - boosted pair kill LIVE at restricted strength; basin discount +0.4 at gamma~0.1 then dodged (window gamma<0.245); corners4 beta=0 emptiness bracket [14.89, 21.32] straddles 21 - OPEN (solver-bound). No certificate emitted; successor = emission oracle loop vs verify_pair.py. Residue: conditioning/FJ cascade (A50-G1) and the priced corners4 mini-tree (docs/proofs/corners4_empty.md sect. 6). A71 (2026-09-02, emission campaign): (1) T2 runs close the restricted tier picture - k4_11 = 21+6*beta and k4_03 = 21+4*beta EXACTLY (margin -beta, zero fractional excess, adequacy tau_f=7.000000 each): the whole one-short critical tier shares the k4_08 signature; stuckness rows now a standalone lemma (docs/proofs/stuck_rows.md SR-1/SR-2, census-exact, canary-saturated), exact P-B image sets G_S={id,diag}/{id}/{diag}/empty for k4_08/k4_11/k4_03/corners4. (2) T1 emission vs the frozen verifier: NO full-quantifier certificate - quantified VERIFICATION WALL (pair_kill.md sect 6.5 Lemma W): exact-rational margin-wall witness (K=11 shrunk-core family, V=39>=28 at eta=0.15) forces >=11 coverage units on sub-0.15-margin atoms for EVERY valid k4_08 beta=1 certificate, while measured frozen-verifier throughput is 57 nodes/s (17.5 ms/node exact Fractions) with leaf-count >=1.4e8 even at impossible all-margins-0.15: v1 emission closed as infeasible-at-scale; residue = pair-certificate-v2 design (margin-aware splitting, compiled second impl, analytic coverage clause) + the measure-existence question. Restricted feasibility UNREFUTED (27 < 28). Canary safe at every step (dilated 60-digit Trump family re-verified as exact death witness, min gap = lambda-1 = 1.06e-7). A73 (2026-09-02, pair-certificate v2 + corners4 pilot): (1) v2 spec (docs/specs/pair_certificate_v2.md; claim identical to v1) with Lemmas S/Q/M/E/F + VACUOUS-CONTAIN + DEFICIENT-EARLY, two implementations from the spec (reference verify_pair2.py + clean-room Rust, C3 cross-validation ALL AGREE, 20k-440k nodes/s): the v1 THROUGHPUT wall is BROKEN - first full-quantifier atom-bearing (P2') PASSes (A73 anchors, 5866/1098 nodes; smaller margin cost FEWER nodes: cost tracks frontier structure, not (1/margin)^6). (2) Lemma W' (pair_kill.md 6.6): weighted shallow service >= tau_2^eta - threshold for every eta. (3) corners4 tau_2^eta curve measured: eta=0.1 dead (>=34 scaled, >=13 forced sub-0.1 units), 0.05/0.02/0.01 unconverged brackets straddling 21 with upper edges 26.2/22.3/21.38 - the fractional wall crosses 21 at eta* in (~0.006, ~0.05), far below Lemma W's integral 0.12-0.15; uniform-eta emission dead, sharp 20.528 open => any valid certificate is a MIXED-DEPTH measure. (4) Tangency trap: LP primals put atoms on membership boundaries (unverifiable); emission must solve eta-deep or deepen post hoc. NO corners4 certificate emitted; residue = emission (deepening/consolidation pass + survey loop + hint trees), priced. Canary SAFE (dilated Trump min gap = lambda-1 = 1.06e-7). || 2026-09-03 PI direction: BOTTOM-UP complement dispatched as A76 — enumerate (by construction) the grains adjacent to Trump within radius R on each protected stratum, discharge rigid grains by exact Krawczyk and flexible ones by drain/FJ, hand the certified R to A74 as an enlarged basin-exclusion row P-B(R). Verification residue measured: unhinted Rust survey caps at 84.5% certain with factor B's tilt unsplit; spec-s4 hint trees (emitter-side, verifier untouched) raise caps to 99.8% certain and harvest 7317 exact continuum counterexample rows -> survey loop iterating. NO corners4 PASS yet; T2 not started.

C.CC2 — CC-2/CC-2' exchange (teleport) lemma + clear-corner 2-crowd [proved-prose] Subsumes A53 L6. Trump is teleport-extremal (canary). Feeds C.K4TIER, does not close it. A75 LEAN PARTIAL (Selection.lean): teleport_packing (the exchange preserves the packing at the same side - no corridor hypothesis) + cc2_stuck / cc2_two_meeters (CC-2/CC-2-prime at a k-maximal packing) are theorems CONDITIONAL on the census interface hinc (teleporting a non-simple square onto a completable slot raises k); hinc = F11/H2 debt, same as hface.

C.T5T11 — Logic-kill rules T5/T11 (+ pinguard semantics) [lean-proved] H5: the A54 unsoundness is fixed and gated, but the fix is a code invariant + notes, not a standalone lemma document. A75: the two RULES are Lean theorems (Zones.lean: core_meet_same_square = T5 contradictory-box kill; refine_cover = T11 same-witness refinement, same budget). The pinguard PARENT classification is the case where witness = pin is consistent (reduced budget unsound) - a certification GATE (code invariant, pinguard.classify), not a lemma; the label covers the rules, the gate stays procedural.

LEAN-PROVED (A75, Zones.lean): strictFamily_mono + M1_transfer (an s0 case certificate with s-independent cores kills every s <= s0) + M1_transfer_packing (lambda-dilated). The single-corner clause = "coreSets identical at every side" (beta = 0 slots).
C.A61 — 12 s0-only strata + 2 sliver bands [open] Bounded compute per A56's recipe, not theory.
D.TREE — trump5 residual: zone-tree discharges the stratum into the basin [open] GO-priced finite program; every kill an exact certificate. Open until the campaign closes; window form is D.SLAB.

LEAN-PROVED (A75, Zones.lean): centre_separation (N1.0, inscribed-disk midpoint argument via mem_interior_iff_uv), at_most_one_centre (N1.0.1), zone_assign_injective/_unique/_bijective (N1 (i)-(iii)); the per-instance exact checks (footprint diameter, disjointness) stay the certificate side.

D.TRAP — Upward trap: all six one-cell Young completions of trump5 certified empty [certificate+verifier] Drain cannot escape upward at s0; window form = A56's six-class ticket (partially open, see C.WIN).
D.P1 — A59-P1: trump5 packings have a square centred in [1.1,2.777]^2 [certificate+verifier] Exact cert, re-verified depth 60.

D.LADDER — Residue ladders terminate into the basin (depth-2/3 conditioning) [open] H11 SUSPECT #1 (was 'extrapolated'). The A60 falsifier VINDICATED the suspicion: at A59's basin radius the ladders DIVERGE (18->620 boxes); they terminate only at the corrected conditioning radius r=4.45e-4 (level 24, 15-35 boxes, all inside the basin). Now measured, not extrapolated; still open until the full campaign closes. Also G-A60-2: the zone-cover route is dead for the outer squares; confinement is the verified fix.

D.ALIVE — alivewitness: exact disjoint-family bound tau* >= budget [certificate+verifier] The ALIVE-side arbiter; strict positive gaps in exact rationals. Carries the load G-A59-12 would otherwise carry.

D.SLAB — Low-s slab / window form of the residual (H7, G-A59-7) [open] Packings with sigma well below s0 inside trump5 are invisible at fixed-s nodes; the residual tree's (K) leaves need their A56-parametric overhead. The Lean axiom trump_residual quantifies over the whole window, which makes this hole explicit. A63: the dilation bridge transfers KILLS only, never the containment conclusion (pulled-back basin box misses InBasin by ~(lambda-1)|c|); slab remains open; slack-core grid named as the cheapest route. Slack-core grid pricing HELD: A60's measured certification law is eta <= -1 (0.5-slack regime failed on trump5); delta=1e-3 re-emission test in flight.

D.D4 — D4 reduction machine-checked at the working side (H12) [certificate+verifier] A67 2026-09-02: s0 RE-RUN DONE, PASS in 36.7 s (control at 96/25 also PASS; A27 verify_tree2 --skip_leaf_verify anchor PASS). PORTED MECHANICALLY - no assumption bakes in the side; only mutation is verify_tree2.S / refine.S. Exact-rational: R1 Z(s0) concentric with the container; R2 the acting group IS D4 (8 signed perms, closed, orders {1,2^5,4^2}, nonabelian); R3 each g maps [0,s0]^2 and Z onto themselves; R4 the 8 images of the fundamental triangle T COVER Z (octant decomposition exhibited, each octant mapped into convex T on 3 vertices); R5 g(Q(c,th)) = Q(g(c),th') with th' = th / 90-th, i.e. t -> (1-t)/(1+t) (polynomial identity in t, deg <= 2, 5 points); R6 verify_tree2 check (2) verbatim (216 cells, cell<->box exact, none vacuous/coreless); R7 check (6) bookkeeping + t-bins are SIDE-INDEPENDENT (identical at 96/25 and s0); R8 CENSUS SIDE - A53 skeletons.py d4_images is the SAME group of plane maps as the container D4 at s0, preserves the slot lattice and corner anchors, canon is orbit-invariant/selecting on 7204 locked sets (944 classes) and the 1110 Young slot-sets (163 classes, = B.CENSUS), and the Young slot map is D4-equivariant g.slots(c,lam) = slots(g.c, lam or lam^T) - this is the action instratum_bridge.md E.2 consumes. SCOPE (d4_reduction_s0.md D4.4): conditional on the ROOT occupancy lemma at s0, which does NOT exist (it exists only at 3.84); verify_tree2's cert-consuming checks (1)(3)(4)(5)(7) have no input at s0 because there is no s0 case tree - that is D.TREE, not D.D4. Says nothing about S11 (seam S6 = D.S6, still open) and proves no bound (it is a WLOG). Reported non-assertion: sigma(box) is NOT inside the mirror box in t-coords (~5.3e-8, both directions) - the documented t_lo/t_hi outward-rounding artefact verify_tree2 works around by using the image box; identical at 3.84.
